column1: # MINIMAL MACHINE's words for the screen reader (fm1-reader): the screen's text <TAB> what to say. "#" a number, "*" a
# word left out. tools/gen_words.py makes web/words/<id>.json and the link the FM-1 sends. Change a line and a new
# file is made: keep the old ones (devices in the wild point at them).
# "A" is the note: not the article (the reader says a capital A before a word as "a")
